C01.instruction: Report the ridge tarn fee posted on the bothy grit sheet.

C02.instruction: Report the scree fell due on the glen peat sheet.

C03.instruction: Name the bothy skipper listed on the tarn crag card.

C04.instruction: Give the wire status for the north tor dock slip.

C05.instruction: Report the bracken howe fee on the kist clough sheet.

C06.instruction: Sum the glen wold crate costs that the bothy grit note lists.

C07.instruction: Sum the tor beck crate costs that the ridge note lists.

C08.instruction: Sum the crag grit crate counts that the peat roster lists.

C09.instruction: Sum the kist clough shift hours that the howe card lists.

C10.instruction: Sum the beck peat crate counts that the grit roster lists.

C11.instruction: Report the live ridge crate total from the finance sheet, not the mail quote.

C12.instruction: Report the live scree peat total from the finance sheet, not the mail quote.

C13.instruction: Name the live glen grit clerk from the roster sheet, not the mail copy.

C14.instruction: Give the live kist peat mark from the yard card, not the mail mark.

C15.instruction: Report the live bracken bin total from the finance sheet, not the mail quote.

C16.instruction: Report the crate cost for the fell yard rush crate on the grit sheet.

C17.instruction: Report the crate cost for the glen yard sealed crate on the peat sheet.

C18.instruction: Name the night tarn clerk tagged on the bothy index.

C19.instruction: Give the slip mark for the long north tor dock berth.

C20.instruction: Report the shift hours for the rush fell watch on the clough card.

C21.instruction: Count the glen grit shifts on the calendar that also appear on the peat roster.

C22.instruction: Count the rush tarn notes in the mail that also appear on the grit sheet.

C23.instruction: Count the bothy peat shifts on the calendar that also appear on the kist card.

C24.instruction: Count the fell kist crates on the sheet that also appear on the howe note.

C25.instruction: Count the wold grit notes in the mail that also appear on the clough sheet.

C26.instruction: Name the ridge bothy clerk who appears on the grit sheet, the peat card, and the tarn tag.

C27.instruction: Name the fell grit hand who appears on the wold sheet, the clough card, and the howe tag.

C28.instruction: Give the tor peat mark that appears on the kist sheet, the beck card, and the glen tag.

C29.instruction: Report the clough grit fee that appears on the live sheet, the peat index, and the bothy tag.

C30.instruction: Report the howe bracken due that appears on the live sheet, the tarn index, and the scree tag.
